{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_mask.sum())

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Verify premises
print("\nVerified premises:")
print("- Email campaign targeted high-value customers: confirmed (channel not randomised, see documentation)")
print("- Two channels: email and paid_search: confirmed")
print(f"- Refunded orders dropped: {refunded_mask.sum()} out of {len(df)}")
print(f"- QA orders dropped: {qa_mask.sum()} out of {len(df)}")

# Check final shape
print(f"\nFinal dataset size: {len(df_clean)} rows")"}
